1 · Intro

When to use it.

A leave changes more than the calendar. In Oracle, the assignment status tells HR and payroll whether the person is working, on leave, or back, so it has to change when the leave starts, changes, and ends.

At Vanderbilt you make this change in Change Assignment, which has an action for leave status.

Use this whenAn employee in your area is starting a leave, extending or changing a leave, or returning from one.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Oracle assignment status and payroll effect
StatusWhat payroll does
Active payroll eligibleProcesses the assignment
Suspended, payroll eligibleProcesses the assignment
Suspended, no payrollSkips the assignment
Suspended, process when earningProcesses only in periods with earnings

Watch-outs

  • The assignment status and the absence record are separate. Changing one does not change the other, so check both.
  • Open item: the exact leave status action and status names Vanderbilt uses (paid vs. unpaid leave, return to work) need to be confirmed on screen.
  • Open item: Vanderbilt's leave process is pending review by Sheila, the Leave SME.

HCM Academy job aid · Leave Management

Leave status updates

Use when: An employee in your area is starting a leave, extending or changing a leave, or returning from one. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Open the person: Our Workforce > Employment Info, then search the employee.
  2. Start Change Assignment and choose the leave status action.
  3. Set the effective date to the first day of the leave.
  4. Pick the assignment status that matches the leave.
    • Paid leave: a payroll eligible status
    • Unpaid leave: a no payroll status
  5. Submit, then track the approval with the notifications bell.
  6. If the leave changes, update the status again with a new effective date.
  7. When the person returns, set the status back to active on the return date.
